title: Evaluation of medial meniscus function using ultrasound under extreme knee loading conditions during Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes
summary:
Extreme stress places additional strain on the knee joint and its internal structures. Over time, this can lead to wear and tear (osteoarthritis). The meniscus plays a key role in preventing osteoarthritis. Normally, the meniscus is examined only through a physical examination or an MRI. However, our own research shows that ultrasound (sonography) is much better suited for assessing meniscus function. We observed that under normal stress, a healthy meniscus shifts outward (extrusion). As soon as the stress subsides, it returns to its original shape. 

The study aims to use ultrasound to measure how the menisci adapt to extreme stress caused by cycling during the 2026 Tour de France and the 2026 Tour de France Femmes. Eligible participants include all members of the Lotto-Intermarché cycling team who are competing in the race, have provided written consent, have not undergone any major previous knee surgeries, and have not sustained a serious knee injury within the 3 months prior to the start of the study. Four weeks before the races, the knee joint and menisci will be examined via MRI and ultrasound. In addition, participants will complete questionnaires regarding pain and knee function (VAS, Tegner, KOOS). During the races, immediately before and immediately after each stage, meniscal outward displacement will be measured via ultrasound, and participants will be asked to rate their current pain intensity (VAS). Two weeks after the races, another ultrasound measurement will be performed, along with pain and functional questionnaires (VAS, Tegner, KOOS) and a standardized physical examination. 

All research questions are intended to generate initial ideas (hypotheses) for the future. The primary objective of the study will be analyzed using two linear mixed models, one for the men in the Tour de France and one for the women in the Tour de France Femmes. The analysis will present the adjusted mean value of the meniscus adaptation response for each measurement time point, including a 95% confidence interval.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all riders from Team Lotto-Intermarché who participate in the 2026 Tour de France or 2026 Tour de France Femmes.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•    Member of the Lotto-Intermarché cycling team participating in the 2026 Tour de France or the 2026 Tour de France Femmes
•    No knee injuries in the past 3 months
•    No major knee surgeries (ligament reconstructions, meniscus repairs)
•    Written consent
Exclusion criteria:
•    No team members of the Lotto-Intermarché cycling team participating in the 2026 Tour de France or the 2026 Tour de France Femmes
•    No written consent
•    Relevant previous knee surgery
•    Relevant knee injuries occurring ≤ 3 months before the start of the study
